svg.aria-label: Re-pin map for the body-side plugs, drawn from where each wire is now to where it goes and numbered as in the manual's tables: orange for a wire you move, green for a new wire, dashed for an optional wire or one that may not be there, and an X for a wire that comes out and is insulated. MS43 Touring built 09/2001 to 02/2003, with an M3 donor built from 09/2001: the leak-test heater moves from body X6011 pin 7 to X60004 pin 18 (#1), and only then the clutch wire from X60004 pin 23 into X6011 pin 7 (#2); the oil-pressure lamp moves from 3 to 11, the charge lamp from 4 to 1, the oil level from 5 to 21 and the start feedback from 6 to 2 (#3 to #6); the brake test contact moves from 28 to 34 (#7); a new ground runs from X60004 pin 5 to ground point X1108 (#8, recommended); and the optional Sport button runs from switch-center pin 17 to X60004 pin 15, its LED from X60004 pin 16 to pin 18 (#9). MS45.1 Touring with the M54, from 03/2003, with an M3 donor built from 09/2001, in work order: tag pins 2 and 15 first, because both are black with red; take out and insulate the wires in 5 and 15 and, if fitted, 19 (#2 to #4); then the heater moves from 2 to 18 (#1), the brake test contact from 28 to 34 (#5) and the clutch wire from 23 into X6011 pin 7 (#6); new wires run from 11, 1 and 21 to cluster pins 13, 2 and 17 (#7 to #9); the start feedback moves from X6011 pin 6 to X60004 pin 2 only if pin 6 has a wire, once 2 is clear (#10); a new ground goes into 5 once it is clear (#11, recommended); and the optional Sport wires go into 15 and 16 once 15 is clear (#12). On both cars every wire that crosses between X6011 and X60004 gets a new terminal of the target's type, the M3 clutch module replaces the Touring's, the cluster's three lamp switches are coded to nicht_aktiv, X60004 pin 6 stays empty, pins 20 and 30 stay until tested, and the fuel-pump relay K96 stays on pin 10.
